summary.en: New spatial-proteomics and DIA workflow reports are visible, but their verification is incomplete.
summary.zh: 出现空间蛋白组与DIA流程新报告，但论文信息核验尚不完整。

en: No new papers are presented as fully verified selections today. The Nature Methods listing dates OpenDVP to October 22, and the Journal of Proteome Research listing includes a new comparison of DIA data-processing workflows. Complete authorship, abstract evidence or version details remain unverified, so neither is presented as a reviewed paper.

The check covered accessible publisher listings and indexed records for proteomics, metabolomics and small molecules, lipidomics, imaging, ion mobility and signal processing. Some online-first pages could not be accessed and listings may lag publication. This does not imply an absence of new research.
zh: 今天没有作为已完成核验的精选论文介绍的新条目。Nature Methods目录显示OpenDVP于10月22日发表，Journal of Proteome Research目录也出现新的DIA数据处理流程比较；完整作者、摘要证据或版本细节仍未核实，因此暂不将其作为已审阅论文介绍。
本次检查覆盖蛋白组、代谢组与小分子、脂质组、成像、离子淌度及信号处理的可读出版商目录与索引。部分在线先行页面无法访问，目录也可能滞后；这不表示没有新研究发表。
